findings: GitHub stores ~ in asset names as ., so the publisher could not fetch a tilde version. Fixed in publish.py with a test.
A rollback that names only the core and standalone makes APT remove the gateway and LXC profiles. The first README example did that; it was corrected before publication.

The push of the manifest commit went out while a new manifest test was failing, because the command chain did not stop on it. The failure was the test itself: it used the now published version and the duplicate check fired. Fixed in the next commit. The workflow does not run this test.
